app.title: Beam Calculator
app.subtitle: Finite element analysis of single and continuous beams
app.mobileViewOnly: On narrow screens (< 768 px) results can only be viewed. Please use a larger window for editing.
app.footer: Linear static analysis, first-order theory. All calculations run locally in your browser. Express checks do not replace a code check.

beam.name: Project name
beam.segmentsHint: The beam can be divided into segments with different cross-sections or materials.
beam.author: Engineer

section.label: Cross-section
section.periPermNote: Checked with permissible values (perm M, perm Q, perm R) under service loads 1.0·G + 1.0·Q; I from the chords, E = 11,000 N/mm².
section.periDesignNote: Checked with the design resistances N_Rd, V_z,Rd, M_y,Rd of the net sections A 4-4, A 5-5 and B 2-2 and the interaction n–v, v–m, n–v–m (ULS). No stability check.
section.periGirderNote: Checked with the MULTIFLEX design values (V_Rd, M_Rd, support force F_R,d per support case) for the ULS combinations; edge distance of the end supports. I from the chords, E = 11,000 N/mm².
section.periEc3Note: Checked per EN 1993-1-1 6.2.10 (N–V–M interaction, Wagenknecht) on the net section with bolt holes, γ_M1 = 1.1 (ULS). No stability check.
section.periAtNode: Supports under a lattice node (MULTIFLEX case 1 / 3)
section.periAtNodeHint: Unchecked: supports between the nodes (case 2 / 4, on the safe side: F_R,d = 19.5 / 30 kN, M_m,Rd = 6 kNm).
section.periLatticeNote: Member model as in RSTAB: continuous chords, pin-ended diagonals; design of all members to EN 1993-1-1 (steel) or EN 1999-1-1 (aluminium, with heat affected zone) for all ULS combinations, flexural buckling with the spacing of the nodes or lateral restraints, bearings (couplers or ledger heads), deflection of the framework.
section.flexElements: ULS Flex elements (end element 50 + intermediate elements + end element 50)
section.latticeRestraint: Lateral restraint of the top chord every
section.latticeEccentric: Nodes with gap g (eccentric, system lines of the drawing)
section.latticeEccentricHint: Unchecked: diagonals meet centrically on the chord axis (agrees with the PERI tables). Checked: gap 65 / 79 mm as in the PERI drawings, additional eccentricity moments in the chords.

material.label: Material
material.expressNote: express check, not a code check

support.title: Supports
support.springHint: Spring stiffness per direction; 0 = no spring. Spring force = k · displacement.
support.legend: Fixed: u, w, θ restrained · Pinned: u, w · Roller: w · Sliding sleeve: u, θ (w free) · Spring: springs k_u, k_w, k_θ

hinge.title: Hinges
hinge.hint: Hinge: common displacements u, w, separate rotations θ₁ ≠ θ₂, M = 0.

load.signs: Signs: x to the right, z (deflection) positive downwards. Force angle α measured clockwise from +x (90° = vertically down). Distributed load q > 0 acts downwards, axial load p > 0 in +x. Moment M > 0 clockwise. If q₁ = q₂, editing q₁ changes both values.

lc.title: Load cases
lc.inUse: Load case is used by loads
lc.selfWeightHint: The self weight is assigned automatically to the first load case of category G.

combo.title: Combinations
combo.hint: Default: ULS 1.5·G + 1.5·Q (formwork/falsework, γ_F = 1.5 as in the PERI design information) and 1.0·G + 1.5·Q (favourable G), SLS 1.0·G + 1.0·Q. The strength check uses the ULS, the deflection check the SLS combinations.

settings.selfWeightHint: q_sw = ρ · A · g (g = 9.81 m/s²), per segment
settings.patternLoadingHint: For load cases of category Q all combinations of loaded spans are investigated (envelope).
settings.limitsHint: Limits for the deflection check with the SLS combinations: L = span length, L_c = cantilever length. Typical: L/250 and L_c/125.
settings.upliftCheckHint: Pinned and roller supports take compression only: if the beam lifts off (R_z > 0 in any combination), the support fails.

results.cursorHint: Move the mouse over the schematic or diagrams to read all values at position x.
results.none: No results – please check the input.
results.signs: Sign convention (DIN): N > 0 tension; V > 0 acts in +z on the positive cut face; M > 0 causes tension at the bottom. Deflection w > 0 downwards.

schematic.label: Structural system
schematic.standardHint: Lattice girder: click the circles below the bottom chord to place or remove standards with couplers (ULA / ULS) or supports at standards and connectors (ULS Flex).

kpi.reactionSigns: Support reactions in the global axes of the drawing (z downwards): R_x > 0 to the right (→), R_z > 0 downwards (↓), M_R > 0 clockwise (↻). A support pushing the beam up has R_z < 0.
kpi.expressNote: Express check, not a code check (no stability checks).
kpi.basisULS: Basis: envelope of the ULS combinations
kpi.basisSLS: Basis: envelope of the SLS combinations
kpi.periBasisSLS: Basis: service loads (characteristic combinations, SLS), perm F = R_d/1.5
kpi.periEdge: Edge distance of the end support
kpi.basisChar: Basis: characteristic combination of all load cases (no SLS combination)

lattice.head: ledger heads UH Plus at the rosette
lattice.restraints: Ticks above the top chord: lateral restraints
lattice.mechanism: The member model is a mechanism (check the supports).

err.positive: The value must be greater than 0.
err.nonNegative: The value must not be negative.
err.range: The value must be between {min} and {max}.
err.order: x₂ must be greater than x₁.
err.segmentEnd: The last segment must end at x = {x}.
err.noSegments: At least one segment is required.
err.unknownSection: Profile not found in the section table.
err.wallTooThick: Plate/wall thickness too large for the dimensions.

warn.hingeAtEnd: A hinge at the beam end has no effect and is ignored.
warn.duplicateHinge: Several hinges at the same position – only one is used.
warn.hingeAtClamp: Hinge at a fixed support (or sliding sleeve/rotational spring): the rotation is not restrained, the support acts as a pinned support.
warn.duplicateSupport: Several supports at the same position.
warn.duplicateRestraint: DOF already restrained by another support – the reaction is assigned to the first support.
warn.illConditioned: Stiffness matrix is ill-conditioned (κ ≈ {cond}). Please check the results.
warn.noGCase: No load case of category G – the self weight is not applied.
warn.latticeMixed: Lattice girder: the beam must consist of one lattice girder only – no member model check.
warn.latticeLength: Lattice girder: the length is not a catalogue length ({lengths} m); the nodes are arranged from the girder end.
warn.flexLength: ULS Flex: the elements give the system length {L} m, not the beam length.

mech.noX: No restraint in x direction: at least one pinned support, fixed support or sliding sleeve is required.
mech.rotation: Kinematically unstable: the beam can rotate about the support at x = {x}. Add another support or a fixed support.
mech.twoHinges: Mechanism: two consecutive hinges (x = {x1} and x = {x2}) without a support in between.
mech.part: Mechanism: the region between x = {x1} and x = {x2} is kinematically unstable (too many hinges or too few supports).
mech.numeric: Singular stiffness matrix at x = {x} ({dof}). The system is kinematically unstable.

report.title: Calculation steps
report.unavailable: The calculation steps are available after a successful analysis.

loadSetKind.case: A single load case is investigated (factor 1.0).
loadSetKind.combo: The selected combination is investigated (all spans loaded).
loadSetKind.envelope: For the envelope the calculation steps of its first combination are shown.

report.patternNote: With pattern loading the envelopes follow from superposition of the span-wise solutions; the calculation steps show full loading.
report.s4: 4  Global stiffness matrix and load vector
report.s5: 5  Boundary conditions and system of equations
report.s7: 7  Internal forces and deflections per interval
report.siNote: All values of the calculation steps in SI units: N, m, Pa, rad. Signs: x to the right, z downwards, θ = dw/dx positive clockwise.
report.meshNote: Automatic meshing: {n} nodes at all characteristic points, {e} elements, {d} degrees of freedom (u, w, θ per node).
report.dofTable: Numbering of the degrees of freedom
report.hingeMethod: Hinges are modelled as double nodes: both sides share the DOFs u and w but have separate rotations θ_L and θ_R, so no moment is transferred (M = 0). A point moment at a hinge is assigned to the selected side.
report.keIntro: Plane frame element with the DOFs [u₁, w₁, θ₁, u₂, w₂, θ₂]; axial (EA) and bending (EI) stiffness:
report.portrait: Sparsity pattern of the global stiffness matrix
report.portraitBand: The global stiffness matrix is banded (half bandwidth b = {b}).
report.bandwise: row-wise, only columns within the band
report.equivIntro: Equivalent nodal forces of a linearly varying distributed load on an element of length L:
report.timoEquiv: Timoshenko: the exact fixed-end forces including shear deformation are used (identical for uniform load).
report.springsAdded: Springs added to the main diagonal
report.solverNote: Partitioning into {nf} free and {ns} restrained DOFs (no penalty method). Solution by Cholesky factorisation K_ff = L·Lᵀ (bandwidth {b}) with iterative refinement. Smallest relative pivot d/K_ii = {piv}.
report.displacements: Displacement vector [u, w, θ] per node
report.equilibriumIntro: Global equilibrium of the original loads (not the equivalent nodal loads) with the support and spring forces (moment about x = 0, clockwise positive):
report.endForces: The element end forces follow from the nodal displacements; inside the element the internal forces are obtained exactly from equilibrium with the distributed load.
report.endCheck: Check at ξ = L: M = {M} N·m, V = {V} N, w = {w} m

hand.intro: Statically determinate system: {r} support reactions, 3 equilibrium conditions and {h} hinge condition(s) M = 0.
hand.springs: Hand calculation not available: the system contains spring supports.
hand.indeterminate: The system is {n}-fold statically indeterminate – no classical hand calculation, the FEM solution applies.
hand.singular: The equilibrium conditions have no unique solution.
hand.signs: Reactions in the global system: forces positive in +x and +z (downwards), moments clockwise.
hand.sections: Method of sections: M(x) from the left part at the characteristic points, left (⁻) and right (⁺) of the position.
hand.sectionTable: Bending moments: hand calculation and FEM

report.periValues: Section values of the PERI component {name} (source: {src}):
report.periPerm: Check with permissible internal forces (perm F = R_d / γ_F, γ_F = 1.5) under the actual loads.
report.periDesign: Cross-section check per PERI (ST_was_2024/00040) with the interaction n–v, v–m, n–v–m, ρ = (2·max(0.5; v) − 1)², for the sections A 4-4, A 5-5 and B 2-2.
report.upliftNote: Pinned and roller supports transfer compression only; R_z > 0 (uplift, global z axis downwards) means the support fails.
report.periGirder: Check with the design values of the MULTIFLEX instructions for assembly and use: V_Ed ≤ V_Rd, M_Ed ≤ M_Rd, support force F_Ed ≤ F_R,d per support case (end/intermediate support, position to the nodes or distance from the girder end), for GT 24 the moment at the support M_Ed ≤ M_m,Rd; minimum distance of the end supports from the girder end.
report.periEc3: Cross-section check per EN 1993-1-1 6.2.10 with 6.2.9.1 (6.36), procedure after Wagenknecht, net section with bolt holes (PERI proof ST_kls_2016-00106).
report.periLattice: Plane member model (continuous chords, pin-ended diagonals, rigid end posts); loads on the top chord, both chords supported vertically. Design to EN 1993-1-1 (γ_M = 1.1, M_Rd with α_pl ≤ 1.25, interaction 6.2.9.1, flexural buckling curve a with Annex B, C_m = 1) or EN 1999-1-1 (EN AW-6082 T5: f_0 = 230 N/mm², heat affected zone ρ_o,haz = 0.54, ρ_u,haz = 0.69, buckling class A, γ_M1 = 1.1, γ_M2 = 1.25). Buckling lengths: chords in plane = node spacing, out of plane = spacing of the lateral restraints; web members = system length. Couplers EN 74-1 class B: NK F_Rd = 1.5 · 9.1 kN, UNK F_Rd = 1.5 · 15.1 kN (both chords together); ledger heads UH Plus (Z-8.22-863): V_z,Rd = 30.4 / 13.4 kN, N_Rd = 37.3 kN.
report.latticeTable: Member list: axial force of the governing load arrangement, utilisation η as envelope of all ULS load arrangements.

wizard.title: New project
wizard.welcome: This assistant guides you once through the basic settings and creates your first project. On the next start the last edited project opens automatically.
wizard.prefsHint: All settings can be changed later in the header and under “Options”.
wizard.systemIntro: Choose the structural system as a starting point. Supports, hinges and loads can be edited freely afterwards.
wizard.systemHint: The geometry of the template is scaled to the entered length.
wizard.combosHint: Load cases G, Q, S, W and the EN 1990 combinations are created and can be adjusted under “Load cases”.
wizard.saveDefaults: Save as default for new projects
wizard.saveDefaultsHint: Engineer, system, section, material and analysis options are prefilled for the next new project.
wizard.replaceWarning: The current project “{name}” will be replaced. The browser only keeps the last edited project – save it as a file first if needed.

hints.sigma: σ(x, z) = N/A + M·z/I: red = tension, blue = compression, varying over the section height.
hints.eta: |σ|/f_d per fibre: red = 100 % utilisation and more.
hints.M: Bending moment along the axis: red = positive (tension at the bottom), blue = negative.
hints.V: Shear force along the axis: red = positive, blue = negative.
hints.w: Magnitude of the deflection along the axis.

view3d.controls: Drag = rotate, wheel = zoom, right mouse button = pan.

latticeFields.sigma: Extreme fibre stress σ = N/A ± M/W per member
latticeFields.eta: Utilisation η per member (all ULS combinations)

view3d.latticeHint: Lattice girder as member model: red = tension, blue = compression (for η: red = high utilisation); grey scaffold standards with couplers or ledger heads at the supports.

import.title: Import beam list

rule.supports: Supports: all pinned (fixed). Beams with a single stand rest on the structure with the other end – a pinned support is added at that beam end.
rule.loads: Loads: vertical point loads, Gk as permanent load G, Qk as imposed load Q (characteristic); combinations: ULS 1.5·G + 1.5·Q and 1.0·G + 1.5·Q, SLS 1.0·G + 1.0·Q.
rule.length: Length: catalogue length of the designation (e.g. RCS 248 → 2480 mm); deviations up to 25 mm are adjusted, larger ones reported.
rule.selfWeight: Self weight of the PERI profile is included.

note.oneSupport: beams with a single support – mechanism, add supports
note.ground: continuously bedded on the ground – simplified with supports at the ends and under every load
note.profileMapped: profile not in the catalogue – nearest PERI profile used
note.lengthSnapped: length adjusted to the catalogue length (≤ 25 mm)
note.lengthFromDesignation: length in the file does not match the designation – catalogue length used
note.lengthNotCatalog: no catalogue length – length from the file used
note.outside: load/support outside the beam – moved to the beam end
note.endSupport: beams with one stand – pinned support added at the other beam end (resting on the structure)
note.endSupports: beams without supports in the drawing – pinned supports added at both ends

warn.oneSupport: Only one support – the system is a mechanism. Please add supports.
warn.noSupports: No supports in the file. Please add supports.
warn.ground: Continuously bedded on the ground – simplified: supports at the ends and under every load.
warn.profileMapped: Profile “{name}” not in the catalogue – using {profile}.
warn.lengthSnapped: Length {from} mm adjusted to the catalogue length {to} mm.
warn.lengthFromDesignation: Length in the file {from} mm does not match {name} – catalogue length {to} mm used.
warn.lengthNotCatalog: Length {L} mm is not a catalogue length (nearest: {near} mm) – calculated with the length from the file.
warn.outside: {name} at x = {x} mm lies outside the beam – moved to the beam end.
warn.endSupport: Only one stand in the drawing – second (pinned) support added at the beam end x = {x} mm (resting on the structure). Please check.
warn.endSupports: No supports in the drawing – pinned supports added at both beam ends. Please check.

lattice.title: Member model
lattice.hint: Hover a member: section, internal forces, utilisation.
lattice.legendN: Red = tension, blue = compression; envelope: max solid, min dashed. Reactions R_z in global axes (↓ +).
lattice.legendM: Bending moments of chords and posts (web members pin-ended: M = 0). Reactions R_z in global axes (↓ +).
lattice.legendEta: Utilisation η of all ULS combinations: green ≤ 70 %, yellow ≤ 90 %, orange ≤ 100 %, red > 100 %.
lattice.legendCoupler: Grey: scaffold standards at the supports, orange: couplers at the top and bottom chord.
lattice.legendHead: Grey: scaffold standards at the supports, blue: ledger heads UH Plus at the rosettes; ▲ connectors ULS Flex.
